claim.quote: Here the T2K collaboration reports a measurement that favors large enhancement of the neutrino oscillation probability, excluding values of dCP which result in a large enhancement of the observed anti-neutrino oscillation probability at three standard deviations (3 sigma). ... Our results show an indication of CP violation in the lepton sector.

date.note: A16: the result was first made public via the arXiv v1 submission (9 October 2019), earlier than the Nature publication (2020); the earlier date is used per A16/A9. Published as Nature 580, 339-344 (2020).

key_value_text.quote: The 3 sigma confidence level interval for dCP, which is cyclic and repeats every 2pi, is [-3.41,-0.03] for the so-called normal mass ordering, and [-2.54,-0.32] for the inverted mass ordering.
key_value_text.value: delta_CP 3-sigma confidence interval [-3.41,-0.03] (normal mass ordering) or [-2.54,-0.32] (inverted mass ordering); CP-conserving values (0, +/- pi) excluded at 3 sigma.

name: T2K constraint on the CP-violating phase in neutrino oscillations

summary.plain: T2K compared how often neutrinos and antineutrinos change type on their way across Japan, and found a difference large enough to exclude, at 3-sigma confidence, the possibility that they behave exactly the same. Worded carefully by the collaboration as 'an indication of CP violation' - not yet a discovery.
summary.technical: Combined neutrino- and antineutrino-mode appearance/disappearance data exclude CP-conserving delta_CP values (0, +/-pi) at 3 sigma; 3-sigma interval [-3.41,-0.03] (normal ordering) or [-2.54,-0.32] (inverted ordering). The collaboration's own wording is 'an indication of CP violation in the lepton sector', reproduced verbatim in the claim quote; not classified as 'evidence' or 'discovery' to avoid inflating beyond the paper's own language (v0.2 rule 7 / A16).

title: Constraint on the Matter-Antimatter Symmetry-Violating Phase in Neutrino Oscillations
why_it_matters: The first constraint on the leptonic CP-violating phase delta_CP from any single experiment, disfavouring CP conservation at 3 sigma and pointing towards a possible explanation (leptogenesis) for the universe's matter-antimatter asymmetry; the physics case for Hyper-Kamiokande's more sensitive CP search.
